nodes.label: Hot Document Room
nodes.rationale: Per-document actor holding Y.Doc, subscribers, and dirty state. Evicts 10 min after last subscriber drops, post-flush. Serializes writes per document.

nodes.label: Materialization
nodes.rationale: Derives content/title/fm/plugins from CRDT state. Debounced ~500ms, atomic-with-itself. May trail live CRDT state by one debounce window.

nodes.label: Deleted IDs Graveyard
nodes.rationale: Permanent record of purged document IDs. Prevents long-offline clients from resurrecting deleted documents. IDs never reusable.

nodes.label: Database Migrations
nodes.rationale: Run at boot under advisory lock, ordered and idempotent. Server refuses to start against a database newer than the binary. All indexes declared in one list.
